implementation_commitments_note: 2026-08-22: capage/longitudinal.py and capage/transfer.py hashes updated directly (no rename/preservation) after this pin was independently verified to not protect a real completed paid run -- no .github/workflows/*transfer* file exists, and no GitHub Actions run in the repository's history has 'transfer' in its name. This experiment has never actually executed, so this is not evidentiary history; per standing policy, non-evidentiary pins are updated directly with this kind of note rather than using the rename-and-preserve pattern reserved for pins protecting a real run (see capage/homeostasis_v2_replication.py's REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_SHA256_HOMEOSTASIS_V2_REPLICATION_32349482559 for that pattern). Prior values, for reference: capage/longitudinal.py was 7a8e0cb895807869afe10ac1d9f7e9d6b503b15750d546d0434601e97fb965ab, capage/transfer.py was 3759bac970094f28d4107a6e40baa65b2bd88e54e46305864e942df7c7fac879. Prior value: capage/sandbox.py was 35b4eec2eb80a9184ca5511fdfd72c51a0d26194b7c1b211abe3ffd8e5b0a5d3.
